data.name: Raaju
data.gender_notes: Raaju is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Raaju is a combination of two words: Raja, meaning king or ruler, and U, which signifies protection and power. The name evokes a sense of strength, power, and leadership, reflecting the qualities of a true leader and protector. The name Raaju carries the meaning “Ruler, King” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Telugu, Hindi. Parents who choose Raaju usually hope their child will grow to embody ruler, king and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Raaju is a divine name, associated with the Hindu god Indra, the king of heaven and god of rain. It is believed that the name Raaju bestows upon the bearer the qualities of a powerful ruler and protector, who is revered and respected by all.
data.etymology: Raaju belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Ruler, King.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Raaju total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.
